sentence: Anyone born January 1 through February 3, 1992, that excluded stretch, falls before the boundary and belongs to the outgoing year instead, Xin-Wei (辛未), Metal Goat, the same year this site's [1991 Chinese Zodiac page](/1991-chinese-zodiac/) covers.
The Western zodiac's [Scorpio](/scorpio-dates/) has nothing comparable; a Scorpio is a Scorpio regardless of which year they arrive in.
